headers.name: equal_label_distinct_are_hybrid_occurrences
headers.header:
theorem equal_label_distinct_are_hybrid_occurrences
    (a c : (M).OpenedTip) (hac : a≠c)
    (hlab : (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c) :
    ∃ e f : (M).HybridParentOccurrence, a=Sum.inr e ∧ c=Sum.inr f ∧ e≠f ∧
      (M).graph.target e.val=(M).graph.target f.val

headers.name: actual_paired_tip_empty_boundary_arc
headers.header:
theorem actual_paired_tip_empty_boundary_arc
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v)
    {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C)
    (hface : Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
      (coordinates face.outside)=outside C)
    (a c : (M).OpenedTip) (hac : a≠c)
    (hlab : (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c) :
    ∃ B : Set Schoenflies.Plane, B⊆C ∧
      IsArcBetween B (tipPoint N D b hg hb a) (tipPoint N D b hg hb c) ∧
      ∀ w : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb w∈B ↔ w=a ∨ w=c

headers.name: actual_one_boundary_paired_tip_arcs
headers.header:
theorem actual_one_boundary_paired_tip_arcs
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ C : Set Schoenflies.Plane, IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      (∀ t : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb t∈C) ∧
      ∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, a≠c → (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        ∃ B : Set Schoenflies.Plane, B⊆C ∧
          IsArcBetween B (tipPoint N D b hg hb a) (tipPoint N D b hg hb c) ∧
          ∀ w : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb w∈B ↔ w=a ∨ w=c

headers.name: half_curve
headers.header: private theorem half_curve (e : E) : curve D e (1/2 : ℝ)=coordinates (D.arc e oneHalf)

headers.name: incomingTail_arc
headers.header:
theorem incomingTail_arc (e : CoreTip N b) :
    IsArcBetween (incomingTail N D b e)
      (coordinates (D.arc e.val.val oneHalf))
      (coordinates (D.point (N.graph.target e.val.val)))

headers.name: incoming_tail_parameter_only_core_tip
headers.header:
theorem incoming_tail_parameter_only_core_tip (e : CoreTip N b) (v : CoreVertex N b)
    (t : unitInterval) (ht : (1/2:ℝ)≤(t:ℝ))
    (heq : D.arc e.val.val t=corePoint N D b v) : v=Sum.inr e

headers.name: incomingTail_only_core_tip
headers.header:
theorem incomingTail_only_core_tip (e : CoreTip N b) (v : CoreVertex N b)
    (hv : coordinates (corePoint N D b v)∈incomingTail N D b e) : v=Sum.inr e

headers.name: incomingTails_meet_only_target
headers.header:
theorem incomingTails_meet_only_target (e f : CoreTip N b) (hef : e≠f)
    {z : Schoenflies.Plane} (hz : z∈incomingTail N D b e)
    (hz' : z∈incomingTail N D b f) : z=coordinates (D.point (N.graph.target e.val.val))

headers.name: paired_incoming_tail_arc
headers.header:
theorem paired_incoming_tail_arc (e f : CoreTip N b) (hef : e≠f)
    (ht : N.graph.target e.val.val=N.graph.target f.val.val) :
    IsArcBetween (incomingTail N D b e ∪ incomingTail N D b f)
      (coordinates (D.arc e.val.val oneHalf))
      (coordinates (D.arc f.val.val oneHalf))
